question: layer
answer: National context

question: who records
answer: compiled and published by the Dirección General de Tráfico (catalogue record); the recording police force is not a column of the file

question: unit of observation
answer: one crash with victims; 875,013 rows, 0 duplicate keys (year, ID_ACCIDENTE)

question: inclusion rule
answer: every crash with at least one victim on a public road, urban or interurban; rows reproduce the yearbook's annual crash totals

question: severity definition
answer: deaths within 24 hours and within 30 days, hospitalised over 24 hours, slight injuries, as separate counts; 14.2% of 30-day deaths occur after the first 24 hours

question: geography
answer: 52 provinces and municipality codes; urban or interurban zone

question: when variables are known
answer: time, place, road and conditions at the scene; 30-day deaths after a follow-up of a month

question: observed or coded afterwards
answer: circumstance codes describe the scene; no cause or contributory-factor field in the crash file

question: missing and not specified
answer: median share unrecorded (not specified, unknown or blank) over 30 circumstance fields 52.8%, highest 93% (CONDICION_NIEBLA); 21 fields vary by more than 10 points between provinces

question: identifiers
answer: ID_ACCIDENTE unique within a year; no person or vehicle file in the repository; no key shared with the regional files

question: known recording artefacts
answer: 7 fields whose unrecorded share differs by a factor of 1.5 or more between fatal and non-fatal crashes in at least one region (ACERA, CONDICION_FIRME, CONDICION_METEO, CONDICION_NIVEL_CIRCULA, TITULARIDAD_VIA, TRAZADO_PLANTA, ...); unrecorded shares differ between provinces (see the DGT microdata audit)

question: used for
answer: national trends, province and year comparisons, shares by zone and road; an external test domain for fields validated against the Catalan file (audit decision: DGT microdata stay the national analytical layer and an external test domain for fields validated against another source; they do not train a severity model here)

question: never used for
answer: linking records to the Catalan or Barcelona files; denominators for individual crashes

question: layer
answer: National context

question: who records
answer: DGT (yearbook series, statistical tables, driver census, kilometre estimates from vehicle inspections); INE (resident population)

question: unit of observation
answer: published aggregates: a count for a year (and province, age, sex or vehicle type); 77 DGT files; INE residents by province, age and sex (149,460 rows)

question: inclusion rule
answer: as published; the crash series reconcile with the crash microdata year by year

question: severity definition
answer: deaths within 30 days (the monthly series is also published with deaths within 24 hours); hospitalised injuries

question: geography
answer: Spain and its 52 provinces

question: time coverage
answer: yearbook series from 1993; residents 2002-2025

question: when variables are known
answer: after the year closes

question: observed or coded afterwards
answer: aggregated from records; kilometres are model estimates from inspection odometer readings, by owner age not driver age

question: missing and not specified
answer: a published table has no missing cells; categories such as 'unknown age' are reported as their own rows

question: identifiers
answer: none below the published cell

question: known recording artefacts
answer: category changes between yearbook editions (for example personal mobility vehicles get their own column from 2020)

question: used for
answer: trends, exposure and denominators at the level they are published (Spain or province, year)

question: never used for
answer: rates for individual crashes; per-km rates by driver age (the kilometres are by owner age)

question: layer
answer: Crash microdata: Catalonia

question: who records
answer: published by the Servei Català de Trànsit; the recording body is not a column of the file

question: unit of observation
answer: one crash; 24,478 rows; no identifier in the source (a surrogate cat_crash_id is assigned)

question: inclusion rule
answer: crashes with at least one death or serious injury; fatal crashes equal DGT's crashes with a death within 24 hours in 32 of 32 province-years; all crashes within 0.5% of DGT's crashes with a death or serious injury within 24 hours

question: severity definition
answer: D_GRAVETAT 'Accident mortal' (3,093 crashes) or 'Accident greu'; the death count matches DGT's 24-hour definition (see the inclusion rule)

question: geography
answer: 4 demarcations, 894 municipalities, road and kilometre point

question: when variables are known
answer: place, road, conditions and units involved at the scene; the D_INFLUIT_* 'influence' fields and several road descriptors after the report is completed

question: observed or coded afterwards
answer: the D_INFLUIT_* fields record whether a condition 'influenced' the crash: a judgement coded afterwards, not an observation

question: missing and not specified
answer: 'Sense especificar' and NA placeholders; NA is structural for some fields (no road owner on urban streets)

question: identifiers
answer: none; no person or vehicle rows

question: known recording artefacts
answer: 9 placeholder levels ('Sense especificar' or an unexplained NA) are much rarer among fatal crashes (outcome-dependent recording): D_CARACT_ENTORN, D_CARRIL_ESPECIAL, D_INFLUIT_BOIRA, D_INFLUIT_CARACT_ENTORN, D_INFLUIT_INTEN_VENT, D_INFLUIT_VISIBILITAT, D_SENTITS_VIA, D_TRACAT_ALTIMETRIC; these fields enter only the retrospective administrative model

question: used for
answer: the fatal-against-serious crash model, its temporal and geographic validation, the training domain of the transfer tests

question: never used for
answer: crash frequency (no slight-injury crashes); driving speed (the speed field is the road's limit); linking records to DGT or Barcelona

question: layer
answer: Rich microdata: Barcelona

question: who records
answer: the Guàrdia Urbana (municipal police); published by the Ajuntament de Barcelona

question: unit of observation
answer: six tables keyed by Numero_expedient: bcn_accidents 7,741, bcn_accident_types 7,741, bcn_mediate_causes 7,749, bcn_driver_causes 8,072, bcn_people 17,200, bcn_vehicles 16,536

question: inclusion rule
answer: crashes the Guàrdia Urbana handled in the city, with or without injury: 890 of 7,741 crashes have no victim

question: severity definition
answer: per person: died within 24 hours (11), died after 24 hours (2), hospitalised over 24 hours (247), slight injuries in three kinds, uninjured; not recorded for 1,351 person records

question: geography
answer: 10 districts, 73 neighbourhoods, street and coordinates

question: time coverage
answer: 2025, months 1-12

question: when variables are known
answer: time, place, people, vehicles at the scene; causes (mediate, driver, pedestrian) after the police report

question: observed or coded afterwards
answer: causes are the police's coding: a mediate cause is recorded for 6.1% of crashes, a pedestrian cause for 6.7%

question: missing and not specified
answer: blank count cells mean zero (no explicit zero appears and the counts add up in every crash); blank cause rows mean none recorded

question: identifiers
answer: Numero_expedient links the six tables one crash to many rows; no person or vehicle key; 16,536 vehicle rows against 14,350 vehicles the crash table reports, so vehicle rows are not unique vehicles

question: known recording artefacts
answer: the crash file's UTM columns carry exchanged labels (corrected, offset measured against WGS84); driver causes have no key to the driver concerned

question: used for
answer: person and crash severity, road users, recorded causes; diagnostics and external checks of the Catalan model

question: never used for
answer: trends (one year); unique-vehicle analysis; linking to Catalan or DGT records
